name: Captain Avatar
signature: Captain Avatar(size: 2xs|xs|sm|base|xl|2xl = sm, background: text, avatar: image)
description: A Captain's avatar: a preset capybara (or uploaded image) on its chosen background colour. Always set background; Capy's default is capy-avatar-1 on #ffffff ('None'), and new Captains get a random preset on a random palette colour. Sizes: 2xs 10 · xs 16 (pane tabs, palette rows) · sm 24 · base 32 (sidebar Captain rows) · xl 48 · 2xl 80. Radius is --radius-xs up to sm, --radius-sm from base.

code.name: CaptainAvatar
code.snippet: span[role=img] class 'flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden leading-none' + vPt[size] {2xs:'size-2.5 rounded-(--radius-inner) text-[9px]', xs:'size-4 rounded-(--radius-inner) text-2xs', sm:'size-6 rounded-(--radius-inner) text-xs', base:'size-8 rounded-(--radius-sm) text-sm', xl:'size-12 rounded-(--radius-sm) text-2xl', '2xl':'size-20 rounded-(--radius-sm) text-4xl'}; style={{background: avatar.background}}; child img 'size-full object-cover select-none' src=/avatars/${preset}.png. Default {kind:'preset', value:'capy-avatar-1', background:'#ffffff'}.

props.name: background
props.description: One of the 12 palette colours (None #ffffff, Sapphire Blue #4471D0, Galaxy Purple #AE69B1, Blushing Pink #CE7492, Capy Brown #AC6A51, Godmode Red #B44D45, Pelican Orange #EF722A, Yuzu Yellow #E0A033, Olive Hay #AAA344, Grass Green #77AD40, Envious Emerald #5AAB6B) or a custom hex.
